title: Open Season and Qualifying Life Event Enrollment in TRICARE Select
content:
**Provision.** Outside the open season (the Monday of the second full week of November through the Monday of the second full week of December, effective January 1) a **TRICARE Select** enrollment rests on a qualifying life event that DEERS has recorded for the beneficiary; the caller's own account of the event is never a substitute for the DEERS record. The enrollment application must be received no later than the tier's qualifying-life-event window after the qualifying life event recorded in DEERS. A qualifying-life-event enrollment takes effect on the DEERS event date. An application that misses the window is rejected; the beneficiary may enroll at the next open season or after a new event.

## Counting the window

- **Clock starts from:** the qualifying life event recorded in DEERS for the beneficiary, read from its DEERS event date; the application names that DEERS life-event record.
- **Counting:** calendar days, starting the day after the DEERS event date; the last timely day is the event date plus the window days (the window is 90 calendar days in every Select tier).
- **Comparison:** the application must be received on or before the last timely day; receipt on that day itself is timely, and receipt the next day is not.
- **Authority:** the DEERS record, checked before the application is registered.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 90-day window)

| DEERS event date | Application received | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-10 | 2026-06-08 (the 90th day after the event) | timely; enrollment effective 2026-03-10 |
| 2026-03-10 | 2026-06-09 (the 91st day) | missed; the application is rejected |
| 2026-03-10 | 2026-03-11 | timely; enrollment effective 2026-03-10 |

## Questions the rule answers

**What date does a timely life-event enrollment take effect?** The DEERS event date, not the application date.

**What happens to an application received after the last timely day?** It is rejected; the beneficiary may enroll at the next open season or after a new qualifying life event.
